name: linkedin-ads-budget-pacing
description: Use for "am I on track with my LinkedIn Ads budget", "will I overspend on LinkedIn this month", "how much should I spend a day on LinkedIn Ads", "which LinkedIn campaigns are budget-limited", "why won't my LinkedIn campaign spend", "we underspent on LinkedIn and I don't know why", or a mid-month LinkedIn Ads spend check — even when the user never says "pacing". Also use when someone needs to know whether more budget on a LinkedIn campaign would buy anything. LinkedIn Ads only.
